children: Natasha Ovsepyan, through Takeover Time 2026 LLC, disclosed a 62.45% stake in CHEETAH NET SUPPLY CHAIN SERVICE INC.'s Class A common stock. The Schedule 13D was filed on Sep. 21, 2026 after the Sept. 17, 2026 purchase of 1,846,000 shares. The size of the holding gives her effective control and sets up a push for board representation.
Ovsepyan plans to join the company’s board and seeks formal representation. In the filing, she "intends to seek a seat on the Issuer's Board of Directors" for herself.

She also asked the company to begin talks right away, stating she "requests that the Board promptly contact Ms. Ovsepyan" to discuss her addition to the board and the steps needed to support her participation in governance.

Takeover Time 2026 LLC is a Delaware limited liability company that invests in securities and related activities. Natasha Ovsepyan is its sole owner and managing member and is a U.S. citizen. The filing states neither the LLC nor Ovsepyan has faced criminal convictions or relevant civil judgments in the past five years.
